verdict.rationale: Firstbase's pricing page lists "Easy financial data exports" for its bookkeeping tier, which is a first-party export capability, but only for financial data and with no stated formats. Nothing in the evidence covers exporting all account data (documents, compliance records, mail scans) or a documented offboarding path. Missing for 10: an export covering all data rather than just financial data, any specification of open file formats, documentation of exporting documents, mail scans and compliance records, a documented account-exit or offboarding process, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
